verdict.rationale: GitHub docs explicitly advertise a Playground for rapidly testing and iterating on prompts, sessions and traces in the UI, and prompt docs mention instant testing/deploying of prompt changes and version tracking. However, there's no explicit evidence of variable/templating support within the playground UI, no hands-on/independent confirmation of the playground experience, and no detail on live model comparison or variable injection workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the playground, explicit documentation of variable substitution in playground testing, and detail on comparing multiple models side-by-side in that UI.
